skill.name: Prisma
skill.description: Write efficient Prisma queries, design schemas, and avoid common ORM pitfalls.
skill.summary: Schema Design Traps - `@default(cuid())` over `@default(uuid())` for IDs—shorter, URL-safe, still unique - `@updatedAt` doesn't update on nested writes—must touch parent record explicitly - Implicit many-to-many creates
